evals.name: web-withdraw-with-requirement
evals.prompt:
write the test cases for AO-618 so QA can run them on the web app. jira is down rn so here's the ticket:

AO-618 [Pay][Web] Fiat withdrawal form
As a trader I want to withdraw USD to my saved bank account.
AC-1: User selects one of their saved bank accounts
AC-2: Minimum withdrawal is 10 USD
AC-3: User cannot withdraw more than the available USD balance
AC-4: Fee is 1% of the amount, minimum 2 USD, and is shown before confirming
AC-5: Users whose KYC is not approved cannot withdraw
AC-6: A confirmation step shows bank, amount, fee and the amount received
AC-7: If the daily limit is hit, show an error and do not submit
evals.expected_output: specs/testcases/AO-618.md with Setup (flag, KYC account, bank account, balance), a Behaviors table citing AC-1..AC-7 and code lines, web cases using real labels. The AC-5 KYC behavior is full (WithdrawForm.test.tsx) and has no case. Cases are rows of one collapsed table, one ★ case with video proof first, every case has a Proof line and numbered Checks.
assertions: Every test case links to behaviors
No Questions section in the file
Cases are one table, a row per case
Every row is collapsed by default
Blank line after each summary and before each </details>
Every live case has a Proof line that matches its cell
Rows ordered: current (★ first), outdated, removed
Behavior and coverage steps ran in subagents
Behavior sources include requirement ACs and code lines
Every AC-1..AC-7 is in the Behaviors table
KYC behavior is full coverage with no manual case
Minimum-amount behavior is partial and has a manual case
